summary:
Hiraya - "The fruits of one's hopes, dreams, and aspirations".

Hiraya is a platform that enables a community to communicate and collaborate in advancing what we know about astronomy further. 

Hiraya solves the challenge of presenting the enormous data that SPHEREx provides from its 102 IR filters, into a user interface that allows a wide multitude of users to access and learn from the information that SPHEREx provides,  lowering the bar when it comes to accessing and learning about Astronomy.

To those who are curious, who hope, who dream and aspire about space, this is the platform for them.
details:
Project Hiraya provides a community for both hobbyist and professional astronomers to contribute and collaborate in progressing what we know about the our observable universe.

Our project not only brings all SPHEREx data in one accessible place, but also provides the platform for the community to communicate and work together for existing or new discoveries, encouraging more people to enter by lowering the problem of accessibility.

We did this by essentially creating a social website that not only has tools to look up, and analyze SPHEREx data, but also the ability for users to take snapshots of their findings along with its related information and create a post within the website itself for others to see, enabling collaboration.
